topics.title: Cellular Adaptations: Hypertrophy Through Dysplasia
topics.productionRationale: The adaptation ladder (hypertrophy, hyperplasia, atrophy, metaplasia, dysplasia) with the physiologic-vs-pathologic splits — the vocabulary every later injury and neoplasia topic builds on.

topics.title: Cell Injury: Reversible, Irreversible & Ferroptosis
topics.productionRationale: The reversible-to-irreversible timeline (membrane blebbing, chromatin, ribosomes, rupture) and ferroptosis — the mechanism core of the injury section.

topics.title: Apoptosis: Intrinsic, Extrinsic & Misfolded Proteins
topics.productionRationale: The intrinsic (cytochrome C) and extrinsic (Fas, granzyme B/perforin) caspase cascades with the executioner layer and the misfolded-protein arm — the programmed-death mechanism map.

topics.title: Necrosis: The Five Morphologic Patterns
topics.productionRationale: Coagulative, liquefactive, caseous, fat, and fibrinoid necrosis with their mechanism lines and gross/histologic signatures (the page carries the HISTOLOGY banner content).

topics.title: Tissue Hypoxia Susceptibility, Infarcts & Free Radicals
topics.productionRationale: The organ-by-organ hypoxia susceptibility table (brain, heart, kidney, liver, colon), red vs pale infarcts, and free-radical injury — the hemodynamic-territory content of the injury section.

topics.title: Calcification & Radiation Injury
topics.productionRationale: Dystrophic vs metastatic calcification with psammoma bodies, and ionizing-radiation injury — the deposition-and-exposure pair.

topics.title: Amyloidosis: The Deposition Diseases
topics.productionRationale: The amyloid table (primary, secondary, transthyretin, dialysis-related, Alzheimer, atrial, islet, medullary thyroid) with Congo red — the deposition-disease directory.

topics.title: Acute Inflammation: Cardinal Signs & Acute-Phase Reactants
topics.productionRationale: The cardinal signs, the systemic acute-phase reaction (fever, leukocytosis, ferritin, fibrinogen, haptoglobin, hepcidin, procalcitonin), ESR determinants, and the acute-vs-chronic split.

topics.title: Leukocyte Extravasation & Cytokines
topics.productionRationale: The extravasation cascade (margination, rolling via Sialyl LewisX, adhesion, transmigration) with the cytokine mediators — the mechanism engine of the inflammation section.

topics.title: Wound Healing: Mediators & Phases
topics.productionRationale: The tissue mediators (angiogenesis factors, PDGF, metalloproteinases) and the three healing phases (inflammatory, proliferative, remodeling) with the diabetes/steroid delay rule.

topics.title: Granulomatous Inflammation & Scar Types
topics.productionRationale: The granuloma cell cast (lymphocyte, fibroblast, epithelioid, giant cell) with infectious vs noninfectious causes, and hypertrophic scar vs keloid — the chronic-inflammation close.

topics.title: Neoplasia Nomenclature & Progression
topics.productionRationale: The benign-vs-malignant nomenclature tables (epithelial, mesenchymal, blood) and the dysplasia-to-invasive-carcinoma-to-metastasis progression — the vocabulary layer of the neoplasia section.

topics.title: Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.productionRationale: The hallmark table (growth-signal self-sufficiency, anti-growth insensitivity, evasion of apoptosis, limitless replication, sustained angiogenesis, Warburg effect, immune evasion, invasion, metastasis) — the mechanism map of malignancy.

topics.title: Cancer Immunotherapy & Epidemiology
topics.productionRationale: The checkpoint-inhibitor directory (ipilimumab, atezolizumab, durvalumab, avelumab, cemiplimab, nivolumab, pembrolizumab) and cancer epidemiology (incidence vs mortality) — the translational layer.

topics.title: Metastasis: Organ Patterns & Routes
topics.productionRationale: The organ-by-organ metastasis map (bone, liver, lung, brain) with the primary-tumor sources and route logic — the anatomic layer of spread.

topics.title: Oncogenes & Tumor Suppressors
topics.productionRationale: The gene table (receptor tyrosine kinases, transcription factors, antiapoptotic molecules, tumor suppressors) with their cancers — the molecular layer of neoplasia.

topics.title: Chemical Carcinogens & Organ Cancers
topics.productionRationale: The carcinogen table (aflatoxins, alkylating agents, aromatic amines, arsenic, and the rest) with source, target organ, and associated cancer — the exposure layer.

topics.title: Tumor Markers, Molecular Diagnostics & IHC
topics.productionRationale: The tumor-marker directory (AFP through chromogranin), the molecular diagnostics layer (TMB, MSI, HRD, liquid biopsy), and the immunohistochemistry panel (cytokeratin, desmin, neurofilament, PSA) — the diagnostic layer.

topics.title: Paraneoplastic Syndromes & Aging
topics.productionRationale: The paraneoplastic syndromes (dermatomyositis, acanthosis nigricans, Leser-Trélat, hypertrophic osteoarthropathy, hypercalcemia, Cushing, SIADH) and the system-by-system aging changes with lipofuscin — the chapter close (p248 is the near-empty NOTES page, claimed as continuation).
